runs.text: Do not write code. Write between two and four lines for the exercise of reading a line, with the right answer for each one, so that any wrong version fails at least one.

hints.text: Think of possible errors: not checking whether there is a semicolon, cutting somewhere else, forgetting a part.
You need a line without a semicolon.
You need a line with two semicolons.
uncover the three wrong versions. Close with the variant.

runs.text: Which of your lines could you remove without letting any wrong version escape?
Wrong versions: it does not check the semicolon, it cuts at the last one and it shows the name without the stock. Without a line with two semicolons, the second one survives.
